title: DSP-CSM-10Z7 - Digital Motor Protection Relay/C Series
description: Samwha DSP-CSM series. Digital Motor Protection Relay/C Series.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Panel Flush Mounting Type
Access restricted to authorized operator : Password
Compact size,Multi function
– Protection : Over current/Under current/Phase loss/Reverse phase/Locked rotor/Current unbalance,Ground fault,Short Circuit
– Indication :Current/L1-L2- L3 , earth current, Load Factor[operating/preset “oc”],Alarm ,Trip,Accumulated working time[AWT]
– Digital communication : RS485/Modbus,RTU
To show a trip cause and operational information in a character and/or a number : 5 Digit Window
To indicate a necessasary information in every 3 sec: current(L1,L2,L3),earth current, load factor
Convenient installation of ZCT to sense a zero-phase current for GF protection
– Standard type : to use external ZCT(200mA/1.5mA)
– Optional type : to use embedded ZCT (not suitable for external CT application)
– Optional:Embedded ZCT/not available for external CT application
High sensitive level and wide range for ground fault protection :30mA∼2A/Zero-phase sequence current
RS485 Serial network Communication
– Possible to monitor the operation data by "Samdsp"
– Possible to construct data base for the operation data by "Samdspdb”
Alarm for disconnection with ZCT
Alarm before Tripping by over current
to check and/or to change preset value of each mode during the operation
– Possible to check :press "SET" key
– Possible to check and to change : firstly make "oPSEt" mode "on",then press "SET" key
procedure after pressing "SET" key is same manner with usual preset job
Various way to reset after trip: Manual,Electrical or Automatic /to response flexibly for applied sequence system
Self-diagonostic test by one touch for "CLR" key
History,Latest 8 trip events

rows: Reverse phase trip delay time : within 0.5sec
Ground fault trip delay time : Edt/1~25sec,Eot/1~30sec
locked rotor trip delay time : dt+0.1sec
Short circuit trip delay time : within 0.05sec
Aux:05-06-08 : 1c(1-SPDT),3A/Resistive(possible to alarm output one of Ec/Ec-tb/AL/uc/Shoc

specs.group: Stable operation under frequency variation from Inverter : 30Hz ∼ 400Hz ,avg ±5%
Lightning Impulse Voltage Withstand Test : IEC-60255-5
1MHz Burst Immunity Test / IEC 61000-4-18 : 2.5KV, Positive / Negative under 2sec
Radiated Electromagnetic Field Disturbance / IEC-61000-4-3 : Level 3, 10V/m
